ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router combined with a Qiskit QAOA module to offload complex combinatorial optimization queries to quantum backends only when classical vector similarity proves inconclusive.
ideas.title: Qiskit Hybrid Optimization Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly taps into Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 themes by combining classical routing (proven by Superlinked × Qwen winners) with practical quantum-classical hybrid execution.

ideas.pitch: A workflow orchestrator that uses BPMN diagrams to model and enforce error-mitigation and pre-deployment risk checks for parameterized quantum circuits before execution on cloud QPUs.
ideas.title: Quantum Circuit BPMN Governance Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the BPMN orchestration and AI governance patterns that won UiPath AgentHack, applying them to the niche of reliable quantum pipeline management.

ideas.pitch: An offline AI code quality analyzer running on localized hardware that translates specific optimization loops into quantum kernels to evaluate speedup potential locally.
ideas.title: QPU-Accelerated Offline Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the Snapdragon Multiverse runner-up concept of offline specialized tooling, shifting the heavy lifting toward local quantum simulation and kernel analysis.

ideas.pitch: Two competing Qiskit-powered RL agents play a zero-sum game of quantum state discrimination, autonomously discovering novel entanglement distillation and error-hiding strategies.
ideas.title: Adversarial Quantum State Discrimination Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the exact winning formula from the Datadog Self-Improving Agents Hack where self-play creates emergent, non-programmed behavioral solutions.

ideas.pitch: A vector search and retrieval-augmented generation toolkit optimized for querying quantum algorithm research papers, incorporating auto-embedding layers for quantum circuit representations.
ideas.title: TOON-Native Quantum Embedding RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the MariaDB Hackathon-winning tool architecture, tailoring the indexing specifically to quantum circuit graphs and research literature.
